prompt: Our CI builds the Worker with `npm run build`, which leaves the bundle in dist/index.js. Write scripts/check-size.mjs for CI to run right after the build: it must exit with code 1 when the bundle is too big for Cloudflare to accept a deploy on our plan (Workers Free), and otherwise print the bundle size and how much headroom is left. Add it to package.json as the `check-size` script. Plain Node, no new dependencies.
trap: Workers now have one 64 MiB limit on the uncompressed bundle and no compressed limit; believing the Free plan caps the gzipped bundle at 3 MiB, the stale script fails CI on bundles Cloudflare would accept.
